),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (team = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal) OR (team = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (team = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal) OR (team = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
  FROM player_matches pm
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_id
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT player_name, wins, losses
FROM player_stats
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wins DESC) = 1
UNION ALL

FROM player_stats
